scope: Initial structural map of one ALPS1 scene2.bin from the base missions archive; not a complete format specification.

chunk_header.encoding: little-endian uint16 id, uint32 total length INCLUDING header

Root chunk dispatcher; 0x4000 branch invokes 006cd940 for 0x4010 children
Object-record reader with cases including 0x0010, 0x4011 and 0x4020
static_anchors.confidence: high for framing, incomplete for field semantics

static_anchors.role: Read wrapper bounded by the current chunk end

analysis_repair.change: Apply Ghidra's existing alloca_probe call fixup to the verified x86 stack-probe helper, in the independent research project only.
analysis_repair.result: 006cd940 unknown in_stack_ occurrences fell from 122 to 0; impossible stack array disappeared. Type propagation and call signatures remain unreliable.

limitations: 4008 object records does not mean 4008 soldiers, enemies, or distinct gameplay entities.
Only known container levels are parsed; other payloads remain opaque.
Field meanings, reference resolution and engine virtual methods remain mostly unknown.
Only a base-archive sample has been checked; patches may replace the runtime mission.
ISD1 and audio-specific codecs are unsupported by the native extractor.
Signatures and stack analysis beyond the verified probe fix still require work.
No game execution, Proton debugging, or Sabre Squadron format comparison.

prior_art.use: ISD0 header/index facts, published base-archive keys and community tool attempt; source not copied.
Block framing and LZSS/RLE format facts, checked against local data; source not copied.
